summary: Plan tourism transitions around guest services, seasonal teams and continuity. Explore the five-day course and practical change-management tools.
lede: Change management in tourism organizations helps practitioners plan operational and workforce transitions while guest services continue. For tourism operations, destination and guest-service professionals, the course develops skills in diagnosing service impacts, assessing team readiness and mapping stakeholders, then planning workforce communications and tracking implementation with service-continuity checklists and scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals coordinating changes that affect guest services, tourism workforces, destination partnerships or operating procedures. It is designed for intermediate-level practitioners who already work in tourism operations, destination management or a related service function and need a clearer method for planning and communicating change.
modules: Bridges’ Transition Model for Tourism Teams
RACI Governance for Tourism Change Delivery
prerequisites: Prior experience in tourism operations, destination management, guest services or a related service function is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
